notes.title: Out of the family
notes.content:
Details:
[list]
[*]Family is gone and you can't lose because you didn't feed them
[*]Map interface changed, now you only can see 3 spots info at once, the map is less crowded now
[*]Character moves more flued on the map
[*]You gen less money at the end of the level
[*]Hands rotation is now on Right Shift
[/list]
